test_names: HTTP-context fallback sets RFC 4122 version and variant bits
fallback uses real getRandomValues without requiring randomUUID
fails explicitly if the environment has no secure random source

fix.strategy: Prefer crypto.randomUUID; otherwise use crypto.getRandomValues with RFC 4122 version 4 and variant bits.
fix.generation_lifecycle: Created inside the first submission attempt, retained across retries, reset only when starting another inquiry/form. Not generated during rendering.
fix.failure_handling: If neither secure random API exists, the submission displays an actionable form error rather than crashing during render.
